ja.B: 音楽を導く者のために。エドトンに合わせて。アサフの賛歌。

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: on Jeduthun: in the manner of Jeduthun's singers
decisions.reason: Jeduthun was one of the leaders of the music at the sanctuary in David's time (1 Chronicles 16:41; 25:1). Psalm 39 is "for Jeduthun"; here and in Psalm 62 the word is "on", which may mean the psalm was sung in the style or by the choir that bore his name.

decisions.choice: Jeduthun: the name as read, not as written
decisions.reason: As in 39:1, the Hebrew writes the name with a slightly different spelling and its notes say to read it as Jeduthun. The words follow the form to be read.

decisions.choice: Asaph: a leader of the temple singers
decisions.reason: Asaph was a Levite whom David appointed to lead the singing before the ark (1 Chronicles 16:5-7); his family carried on the work (1 Chronicles 25:1-2). Psalms 50 and 73-83 bear his name.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1, Readable says what a psalm is.

decisions.choice: "Jeduthun", the established French spelling of the name
decisions.reason: Jeduthun was one of David's chief musicians (meaning decision m3). French Bibles have long written his name "Jeduthun"; a transcription such as "Yedoutoun" would be closer to the Hebrew sounds but less familiar.

decisions.choice: según Jedutún (L, B); Para Jedutún (R)
decisions.reason: Jeduthun was one of David's chief musicians; "on Jeduthun" may mean the psalm is sung in the manner of his singers, or is given to them. Spanish uses the usual form of the name, "Jedutún", and "según" at Literal and Balanced, "Para" at Readable, as the English says "on" and "For".

decisions.choice: "여두둔" for Jeduthun
decisions.reason: The established Protestant form of the name of David's temple musician; the title follows the English level by level (meaning decision: in the manner of Jeduthun's singers).

decisions.choice: Jedutum
decisions.reason: The Portuguese form of the musician's name in 1 Chronicles 16:41 and 25:1 (m3), so the reader meets the same man.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 77.
alternatives: spans like the English ones (from verse 2)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "Of Asaph" as "የአሳፍ" (L, B), "አሳፍ የዘመረው" (R); Jeduthun as "ይዱቱን", as Psalm 62:1 and 1 Chronicles 16:41
decisions.reason: Asaph and Jeduthun keep the forms of 1 Chronicles on main; Readable spells out that the psalm is Asaph's, as Readable does with "ዳዊት የዘመረው መዝሙር".

decisions.choice: "यदूतून पर" (L, B), "यदूतून के लिए" (R); "आसाप का भजन" (L, B), "आसाप का गीत" (R)
decisions.reason: Jeduthun is "यदूतून" as in 1 Chronicles 16:38 and Psalm 62:1 in this translation; the prepositions follow the English levels (meaning m3), and the title of the Asaph psalms keeps the form of Psalm 73:1.

decisions.choice: "Идифун"; "по Идифуну" (L, B), "Для Идифуна" (R)
decisions.reason: The singer's name keeps the form of 1 Chronicles 16:38 and 25:1 in this translation; the preposition follows the English level ("on" / "for"), and its sense, in the manner of Jeduthun's singers (m3), is uncertain.

decisions.choice: 'al-yedutun "エドトンに合わせて" (L, B, as 62:1 L), "エドトンのために" (R, as 39:1 and the English R)
decisions.reason: On Jeduthun is perhaps in the manner of Jeduthun's singers (m3, uncertain); Jeduthun エドトン as 1CH and 39:1 (the name as read, m4).

records.literal_gloss: My voice to God, and I will cry out; my voice to God, and he will give ear to me.

en.L: My voice [goes] to God, and I cry out; \q my voice [goes] to God, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give ear to me.
en.B: I raise my voice to God and cry out; \q I raise my voice to God, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will listen to me.
en.R: I call out loud to God for help. \q I call out loud to God, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will hear me.

fr.L: Ma voix [va] vers Dieu, et je crie ; \q ma voix [va] vers Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me prêtera l’oreille.
fr.B: J’élève la voix vers Dieu et je crie ; \q j’élève la voix vers Dieu, pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’écoute.
fr.R: J’appelle Dieu à grands cris pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’aide. \q J’appelle Dieu à grands cris, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’entendra.

sw.L: Sauti yangu [inamwendea] Mungu, nami ninalia; \q sauti yangu [inamwendea] Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atanitegea sikio.
sw.B: Ninapaza sauti yangu kwa Mungu na kulia; \q ninapaza sauti yangu kwa Mungu, ili {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anisikilize.
sw.R: Ninamwita Mungu kwa sauti kubwa anisaidie. \q Ninamwita Mungu kwa sauti kubwa, naye {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atanisikia.

es.L: Mi voz [va] a Dios, y clamo; \q mi voz [va] a Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me prestará oído.
es.B: Alzo mi voz a Dios y clamo; \q alzo mi voz a Dios, para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me escuche.
es.R: Llamo a gritos a Dios pidiendo ayuda. \q Llamo a gritos a Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me oirá.

vi.L: Tiếng tôi [kêu lên] Đức Chúa Trời, và tôi kêu la; \q tiếng tôi [kêu lên] Đức Chúa Trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ lắng tai nghe tôi.
vi.B: Tôi cất tiếng kêu lên Đức Chúa Trời; \q tôi cất tiếng kêu lên Đức Chúa Trời để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lắng nghe tôi.
vi.R: Tôi lớn tiếng kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời giúp đỡ. \q Tôi lớn tiếng kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nghe tôi.

ko.L: 내 목소리가 하나님께 [향하니], 내가 부르짖는다. \q 내 목소리가 하나님께 [향하니], 그분께서 내게 귀를 기울이실 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 하나님께 소리 높여 부르짖는다. \q 하나님께 소리를 높이니, 그분께서 내 말을 들으실 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 하나님께 큰 소리로 도와 달라고 부르짖는다. \q 하나님께 큰 소리로 부르짖으니, 그분께서 들으실 것이다.

pt.L: A minha voz [vai] a Deus, e eu clamo; \q a minha voz [vai] a Deus, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me dará ouvidos.
pt.B: Ergo a minha voz a Deus e clamo; \q ergo a minha voz a Deus, para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me escute.
pt.R: Chamo a Deus em voz alta, pedindo ajuda. \q Chamo a Deus em voz alta, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai me ouvir.

am.L: ድምፄ ወደ እግዚአብሔር [ይወጣል]፤ እጮኻለሁም፤ \q ድምፄ ወደ እግዚአብሔር [ይወጣል]፤ እርሱም ያደምጠኛል።
am.B: ድምፄን ወደ እግዚአብሔር አንሥቼ እጮኻለሁ፤ \q ያደምጠኝ ዘንድ ድምፄን ወደ እግዚአብሔር አነሣለሁ።
am.R: ርዳታ ለማግኘት ወደ እግዚአብሔር በብርቱ እጣራለሁ። \q ወደ እግዚአብሔር በብርቱ እጣራለሁ፤ እርሱም ይሰማኛል።

hi.L: मेरी आवाज़ परमेश्वर की ओर [जाती है], और मैं पुकारता हूँ; \q मेरी आवाज़ परमेश्वर की ओर [जाती है], और वे मेरी ओर कान लगाएँगे।
hi.B: मैं परमेश्वर की ओर अपनी आवाज़ उठाकर पुकारता हूँ; \q मैं परमेश्वर की ओर अपनी आवाज़ उठाता हूँ, कि वे मेरी सुनें।
hi.R: मैं सहायता के लिए परमेश्वर को ऊँचे स्वर से पुकारता हूँ। \q मैं परमेश्वर को ऊँचे स्वर से पुकारता हूँ, और वे मेरी सुनेंगे।

ru.L: Мой голос — к Богу, и я взываю; \q мой голос — к Богу, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} внемлет мне.
ru.B: Я поднимаю голос к Богу и взываю; \q я поднимаю голос к Богу, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} услышал меня.
ru.R: Я громко зову Бога на помощь. \q Я громко зову Бога, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} услышит меня.

ja.L: わたしの声は神に[向かい]、わたしは叫ぶ。 \q わたしの声は神に[向かう]。その方はわたしに耳を傾けてくださる。
ja.B: わたしは神に向かって声を上げ、叫ぶ。 \q 神に向かって声を上げる。その方が聞いてくださるように。
ja.R: わたしは、大声で神に助けを求める。 \q 大声で神に叫ぶ。その方は聞いてくださる。

decisions.choice: and he will give ear: so that he may listen
alternatives: and he gave ear to me
decisions.reason: The verb form (ha'azin with "and") usually looks ahead: the cry is raised so that God will hear. The psalm then tells of a long night in which he seemed silent (verses 3-10).

decisions.choice: God: the name used in Psalms 42-83
decisions.reason: Like the other psalms of Asaph, this psalm mostly says "God" ('Elohim), and uses the short form of the divine name only once (verse 12).

decisions.choice: I raise my voice (B); I call out loud (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the short Hebrew phrase "my voice to God" into a full sentence.

decisions.choice: The singer speaks about God in the plain written style with "나" (verses 2-4, 6-11) and to God in 합쇼체 with "저" where the Hebrew says "you" (verse 5, and from the middle of verse 12 to the end)
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a. The psalm moves between brooding about God and speaking to him; the Korean speech level follows each turn the Hebrew makes.

decisions.choice: God (Elohim) as "እግዚአብሔር" through Psalms 77-83; "my God", "God of Jacob" as "አምላኬ", "የያዕቆብ አምላክ"
decisions.reason: In these psalms Elohim names the one God, so Amharic says "እግዚአብሔር" (docs/amharic-style.md 7a); "አምላክ" is kept for "a god" and for God with a possessor.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; honorific "वे" for God, "तू" when the psalm speaks to him
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change and the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7). Respect for God is carried by the honorific third person.

decisions.choice: veha'azin "耳を傾けてくださる" (L), "聞いてくださるように" (B), "聞いてくださる" (R); God "その方", never 彼
decisions.reason: "And he will give ear" may express purpose (m1), as the English B; God in the third person is その方 (PSA-1).

source.text: בְּי֥וֹם צָרָתִי֮ אֲדֹנָ֪י דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי יָדִ֤י׀לַ֣יְלָה נִ֭גְּרָה וְלֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] day of my distress [the] Lord I sought; my hand [by] night was stretched out and did not grow numb; refused to be comforted my soul.

en.L: In the day of my distress I sought [the] Lord; \q at night my hand was stretched out and did not grow numb; \q my soul refused to be comforted.
en.B: When trouble came I looked for the Lord; \q all night I kept my hands raised and did not tire, \q and I would take no comfort.
en.R: When I was in trouble, I went to the Lord for help. \q All night long I held up my hands to pray and did not stop. \q Nothing anyone said could comfort me.

fr.L: Au jour de ma détresse, j’ai cherché [le] Seigneur ; \q la nuit, ma main s’est tendue et ne s’est pas engourdie ; \q mon âme a refusé d’être consolée.
fr.B: Quand la détresse est venue, j’ai cherché le Seigneur ; \q toute la nuit j’ai gardé les mains levées sans me lasser, \q et je refusais toute consolation.
fr.R: Quand j’étais dans le malheur, je suis allé vers le Seigneur pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’aide. \q Toute la nuit, j’ai levé les mains pour prier, sans m’arrêter. \q Rien de ce qu’on me disait ne pouvait me consoler.

sw.L: Katika siku ya taabu yangu nilimtafuta Bwana; \q usiku mkono wangu ulinyooshwa wala haukulegea; \q nafsi yangu ilikataa kufarijiwa.
sw.B: Taabu ilipokuja nilimtafuta Bwana; \q usiku kucha niliinua mikono yangu bila kuchoka, \q wala sikukubali kufarijiwa.
sw.R: Nilipokuwa katika taabu, nilimwendea Bwana nipate msaada. \q Usiku kucha niliinua mikono yangu kuomba wala sikuacha. \q Hakuna neno la mtu yeyote lililoweza kunifariji.

es.L: En el día de mi angustia busqué [al] Señor; \q de noche mi mano se extendía y no se cansaba; \q mi alma rehusaba ser consolada.
es.B: Cuando llegó la angustia, busqué al Señor; \q toda la noche mantuve las manos alzadas sin cansarme, \q y no quise recibir consuelo.
es.R: Cuando estaba en problemas, fui al Señor a pedir ayuda. \q Toda la noche levanté las manos para orar y no paré. \q Nada de lo que me decían podía consolarme.

vi.L: Trong ngày gian truân tôi đã tìm kiếm Chúa; \q ban đêm tay tôi giơ ra không mỏi; \q linh hồn tôi không chịu được an ủi.
vi.B: Khi gặp hoạn nạn, tôi tìm kiếm Chúa; \q suốt đêm tôi giơ tay lên không mỏi mệt, \q và tôi không chịu để ai an ủi.
vi.R: Khi gặp khó khăn, tôi đến với Chúa để xin giúp đỡ. \q Suốt đêm tôi giơ tay lên cầu nguyện không ngừng. \q Không lời nào của ai có thể an ủi tôi.

ko.L: 내 고난의 날에 내가 주님을 찾았다. \q 밤에 내 손을 펴고 지치지 않았으며, \q 내 영혼이 위로받기를 거절하였다.
ko.B: 고난이 닥쳤을 때 나는 주님을 찾았다. \q 밤새도록 손을 들고 지치지 않았으며, \q 어떤 위로도 받지 않으려 했다.
ko.R: 어려움을 당했을 때 나는 주님께 도움을 구했다. \q 밤새도록 손을 들고 기도하며 멈추지 않았다. \q 누가 무슨 말을 해도 위로가 되지 않았다.

pt.L: No dia da minha angústia busquei [o] Senhor; \q de noite a minha mão se estendia e não se cansava; \q a minha alma recusou ser consolada.
pt.B: Quando veio a aflição, busquei o Senhor; \q a noite inteira mantive as mãos erguidas, sem me cansar, \q e não aceitei consolo.
pt.R: Quando eu estava em apuros, fui pedir ajuda ao Senhor. \q A noite toda levantei as mãos para orar e não parei. \q Nada do que me diziam podia me consolar.

am.L: በመከራዬ ቀን ጌታን ፈለግኩ፤ \q በሌሊት እጄ ተዘርግታ ነበር፤ አልዛለችምም፤ \q ነፍሴ መጽናናትን እንቢ አለች።
am.B: መከራ በመጣብኝ ጊዜ ጌታን ፈለግኩ፤ \q ሌሊቱን ሁሉ እጆቼን ዘርግቼ ሳልታክት ቆየሁ፤ \q ማጽናኛም አልተቀበልኩም።
am.R: በተቸገርኩ ጊዜ ርዳታ ለማግኘት ወደ ጌታ ሄድኩ። \q ሌሊቱን ሙሉ ለጸሎት እጆቼን ዘርግቼ አላቋረጥኩም። \q ማንም የሚለው ነገር ሊያጽናናኝ አልቻለም።

hi.L: अपने संकट के दिन मैंने प्रभु को खोजा; \q रात को मेरा हाथ फैला रहा और सुन्न न हुआ; \q मेरे प्राण ने सांत्वना पाने से इनकार किया।
hi.B: जब संकट आया, तो मैंने प्रभु को खोजा; \q रात भर मैं अपने हाथ उठाए रहा और न थका, \q और मैंने कोई दिलासा न लिया।
hi.R: जब मैं संकट में था, तो मैं सहायता के लिए प्रभु के पास गया। \q रात भर मैं प्रार्थना में हाथ उठाए रहा और रुका नहीं। \q किसी की कोई बात मुझे शान्ति न दे सकी।

ru.L: В день моей беды я искал Господа; \q ночью моя рука была простёрта и не ослабевала; \q моя душа отказывалась утешиться.
ru.B: Когда пришла беда, я искал Господа; \q всю ночь я держал руки поднятыми и не уставал, \q и не принимал никакого утешения.
ru.R: Когда у меня была беда, я пошёл к Господу за помощью. \q Всю ночь я поднимал руки в молитве и не переставал. \q Ничьи слова не могли меня утешить.

ja.L: わたしの苦難の日に、わたしは主を尋ね求めた。 \q 夜、わたしの手は差し伸べられたまま、しびれることがなかった。 \q わたしの魂は慰めを拒んだ。
ja.B: 苦しみが来たとき、わたしは主を求めた。 \q 夜通し、わたしは手を上げ続け、疲れることがなかった。 \q わたしは慰められることを拒んだ。
ja.R: 困ったとき、わたしは主のもとに行って、助けを求めた。 \q 一晩中、わたしは手を上げて祈り、やめなかった。 \q だれが何を言っても、わたしは慰められなかった。

decisions.choice: my hand stretched out: lifted in prayer
decisions.reason: Spreading out the hands toward God is the posture of prayer (Exodus 9:29; 143:6). The psalmist prayed all night without letting his hands drop.

decisions.choice: was stretched out and did not grow numb
alternatives: my hand (my wound) ran and did not stop
decisions.reason: The verb (nagar) means to pour out or flow, and is used of eyes streaming with tears (Lamentations 3:49). With "hand" it is taken as stretched out in prayer; it may instead picture a sore that kept running.

decisions.choice: refused to be comforted: like Jacob mourning Joseph
decisions.reason: The same words are used of Jacob, who refused to be comforted when he thought Joseph was dead (Genesis 37:35).

decisions.choice: I
decisions.reason: As in Psalms 1-12, nefesh is "soul" at Literal and the whole person at Balanced and Readable.

Nefesh is "प्राण" at Literal and the whole person at Balanced and Readable, as the poetry note and the English have it. "सांत्वना पाने से इनकार किया" is the wording of Genesis 37:35 in this translation, which the line echoes (meaning m3).

decisions.choice: "моя душа" (L); "я" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The poetry note: nefesh is "душа" at Literal; Balanced and Readable say the whole person, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "my hand was stretched out" "手は差し伸べられたまま" (L), "手を上げ続け" (B), "手を上げて祈り" (R); me'anah hinnachem nafshi "慰めを拒んだ" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The hand is lifted in prayer (m1; the wording is uncertain, m2); refusing comfort recalls Jacob mourning Joseph (m3, Genesis 37:35). nafshi "わたしの魂" (L), "わたし" (B, R).

source.text: אֶזְכְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶֽהֱמָיָ֑ה אָשִׂ֓יחָה׀וְתִתְעַטֵּ֖ף רוּחִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: I remember God, and I moan; I muse, and faints my spirit. Selah.

en.L: I remember God, and I moan; \q I muse, and my spirit faints. Selah
en.B: I think of God and groan; \q I ponder, and my spirit sinks. Selah
en.R: When I think about God, I groan. \q The more I think, the weaker I feel. Selah

fr.L: Je me souviens de Dieu, et je gémis ; \q je médite, et mon esprit défaille. Sélah
fr.B: Je pense à Dieu et je soupire ; \q je réfléchis, et mon esprit s’affaisse. Sélah
fr.R: Quand je pense à Dieu, je gémis. \q Plus je réfléchis, plus je me sens faible. Sélah

sw.L: Namkumbuka Mungu, nami ninaugua; \q ninatafakari, na roho yangu inazimia. Sela
sw.B: Ninamfikiri Mungu na kuugua; \q ninawaza, na roho yangu inafifia. Sela
sw.R: Ninapomfikiri Mungu, ninaugua. \q Kadiri ninavyowaza, ndivyo ninavyozidi kudhoofika. Sela

es.L: Me acuerdo de Dios, y gimo; \q medito, y mi espíritu desfallece. Selah
es.B: Pienso en Dios y me lamento; \q reflexiono, y mi espíritu se hunde. Selah
es.R: Cuando pienso en Dios, me quejo. \q Cuanto más pienso, más débil me siento. Selah

vi.L: Tôi nhớ đến Đức Chúa Trời, và tôi rên rỉ; \q tôi suy ngẫm, và tâm linh tôi ngất lịm. Sê-la
vi.B: Tôi nghĩ đến Đức Chúa Trời mà rên siết; \q tôi suy tư, và lòng tôi chùng xuống. Sê-la
vi.R: Khi tôi nghĩ đến Đức Chúa Trời, tôi rên rỉ. \q Càng suy nghĩ, tôi càng thấy mình yếu đi. Sê-la

ko.L: 내가 하나님을 기억하고 신음한다. \q 내가 생각에 잠기니 내 영이 약해진다. 셀라
ko.B: 하나님을 생각하면 나는 탄식한다. \q 깊이 생각할수록 내 영이 가라앉는다. 셀라
ko.R: 하나님을 생각하면 나는 신음한다. \q 생각하면 할수록 기운이 빠진다. 셀라

pt.L: Lembro-me de Deus e gemo; \q medito, e o meu espírito desfalece. Selá
pt.B: Penso em Deus e gemo; \q reflito, e o meu espírito desanima. Selá
pt.R: Quando penso em Deus, eu gemo. \q Quanto mais penso, mais fraco me sinto. Selá

am.L: እግዚአብሔርን አስባለሁ፤ እቃትታለሁም፤ \q አሰላስላለሁ፤ መንፈሴም ይዝላል። ሴላ
am.B: እግዚአብሔርን ሳስብ እቃትታለሁ፤ \q ሳሰላስል መንፈሴ ይዝላል። ሴላ
am.R: ስለ እግዚአብሔር ሳስብ እቃትታለሁ። \q ባሰብኩ ቁጥር ይበልጥ እደክማለሁ። ሴላ

hi.L: मैं परमेश्वर को स्मरण करता हूँ, और कराहता हूँ; \q मैं सोच में डूबता हूँ, और मेरी आत्मा मूर्छित हो जाती है। सेला
hi.B: मैं परमेश्वर के बारे में सोचता हूँ और आहें भरता हूँ; \q मैं विचार करता हूँ, और मेरा मन बैठ जाता है। सेला
hi.R: जब मैं परमेश्वर के बारे में सोचता हूँ, तो कराह उठता हूँ। \q जितना अधिक सोचता हूँ, उतना ही कमज़ोर महसूस करता हूँ। सेला

ru.L: Я вспоминаю Бога и стенаю; \q размышляю, и изнемогает мой дух. Села
ru.B: Думаю о Боге и стону; \q размышляю, и мой дух падает. Села
ru.R: Когда я думаю о Боге, я стону. \q Чем больше я думаю, тем слабее становлюсь. Села

ja.L: わたしは神を思い起こし、うめく。 \q わたしは思い巡らし、わたしの霊は衰え果てる。セラ
ja.B: わたしは神を思い、うめく。 \q 思い巡らすと、わたしの霊は沈み込む。セラ
ja.R: 神のことを思うと、わたしはうめいてしまう。 \q 考えれば考えるほど、力がなくなっていく。セラ

decisions.choice: I remember God, and I moan: memory brings pain
alternatives: when I remember God I moan
decisions.reason: Remembering God at first brings no comfort, because the God who once acted seems far away now. Later in the psalm the same verb (zakar, verses 7 and 12) leads to hope.

decisions.choice: muse: turn over in the mind, or complain
decisions.reason: The verb (siach) means to think something over, often aloud, and can mean to pour out a complaint (55:3; 142:3).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Sê-la", kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 75:4: a word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a musical direction, kept as a word at every level.

decisions.choice: 'asichah "思い巡らし" (L, B), "考えれば考えるほど" (R); Selah "セラ"
decisions.reason: Musing is turning over in the mind, or complaining (m2); memory brings pain (m1). Selah as PSA-1 (m3, uncertain).

source.text: אָ֭חַזְתָּ שְׁמֻר֣וֹת עֵינָ֑י נִ֝פְעַ֗מְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֲדַבֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: You held [the] guards of my eyes; I was troubled and did not speak.

en.L: You held [open] the guards of my eyes; \q I was troubled and could not speak.
en.B: You would not let my eyelids close; \q I was too shaken to say a word.
en.R: You kept me awake all night. \q I was so upset that I could not even speak.

fr.L: Tu as tenu [ouvertes] les gardes de mes yeux ; \q j’étais troublé et je ne pouvais parler.
fr.B: Tu empêchais mes paupières de se fermer ; \q j’étais trop bouleversé pour dire un mot.
fr.R: Tu m’as empêché de dormir toute la nuit. \q J’étais si agité que je ne pouvais même pas parler.

sw.L: Wewe uliishika [wazi] kope za macho yangu; \q nilifadhaika wala sikuweza kusema.
sw.B: Hukuniacha nifumbe kope zangu; \q nilitikiswa mno nisiweze kusema neno.
sw.R: Ulinifanya nikeshe usiku kucha. \q Nilihuzunika sana hata sikuweza kusema.

es.L: Tú mantuviste [abiertos] los párpados de mis ojos; \q estaba turbado y no podía hablar.
es.B: No dejabas que se cerraran mis párpados; \q estaba tan turbado que no podía decir palabra.
es.R: Me tuviste despierto toda la noche. \q Estaba tan angustiado que ni siquiera podía hablar.

vi.L: Ngài đã giữ [mở] mí mắt tôi; \q tôi bối rối và không thể nói được.
vi.B: Ngài không để mí mắt tôi khép lại; \q tôi xao xuyến đến nỗi không nói nên lời.
vi.R: Ngài khiến tôi thức trắng suốt đêm. \q Tôi bối rối đến nỗi không thể nói gì.

ko.L: 주님께서 제 눈의 파수꾼들을 [열어] 붙잡으셨습니다. \q 제가 괴로워서 말할 수 없었습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 제 눈꺼풀이 감기지 못하게 하셨습니다. \q 저는 너무 떨려서 한마디도 할 수 없었습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 밤새 저를 잠들지 못하게 하셨습니다. \q 저는 너무 괴로워서 말조차 할 수 없었습니다.

pt.L: Tu seguraste [abertas] as guardas dos meus olhos; \q fiquei perturbado e não podia falar.
pt.B: Tu não deixavas as minhas pálpebras se fecharem; \q eu estava abalado demais para dizer uma palavra.
pt.R: Tu me deixaste acordado a noite toda. \q Eu estava tão aflito que nem conseguia falar.

am.L: የዓይኖቼን ቆቦች [ተከፍተው እንዲቆዩ] ያዝህ፤ \q ታወክኩ፤ መናገርም አልቻልኩም።
am.B: ዓይኖቼ እንዳይከደኑ አደረግህ፤ \q ቃል እንኳ መናገር እስኪያቅተኝ ተናወጥኩ።
am.R: ሌሊቱን ሙሉ እንቅልፍ ከለከልከኝ። \q በጣም ስለ ተጨነቅኩ መናገር እንኳ አልቻልኩም።

hi.L: तूने मेरी आँखों के पहरों को [खुला] थामे रखा; \q मैं व्याकुल था और बोल न सका।
hi.B: तूने मेरी पलकें बंद न होने दीं; \q मैं इतना घबराया हुआ था कि एक शब्द भी न कह सका।
hi.R: तूने मुझे रात भर जगाए रखा। \q मैं इतना परेशान था कि बोल भी न सका।

ru.L: Ты держал [открытыми] стражей моих глаз; \q я был потрясён и не мог говорить.
ru.B: Ты не давал моим векам сомкнуться; \q я был так потрясён, что не мог вымолвить ни слова.
ru.R: Ты не давал мне уснуть всю ночь. \q Я был так расстроен, что даже не мог говорить.

ja.L: あなたは、わたしの目のまぶたを[開けたまま]押さえられた。 \q わたしは心乱れて、語ることができなかった。
ja.B: あなたは、わたしのまぶたを閉じさせなかった。 \q わたしはひどく動揺して、一言も話せなかった。
ja.R: あなたは、一晩中わたしを眠らせなかった。 \q わたしは心が乱れて、話すことさえできなかった。

decisions.choice: the guards of my eyes: my eyelids
alternatives: the night watches of my eyes
decisions.reason: The word (shemurot) means guards or watches. Here it is taken as the eyelids that guard the eyes, which God held open; it may also mean the watches of the night (63:7; 119:148), which God kept the psalmist awake through.

decisions.choice: you held: God is behind the sleeplessness
decisions.reason: The psalmist turns to God and sees even his sleepless night as in God's hands.

decisions.choice: You kept me awake all night
alternatives: You held the guards of my eyes
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: "तूने" (तू) as the psalmist turns to God
decisions.reason: The psalmist speaks to God here (meaning m2), so Hindi says "तू", as people do when they speak to God in this translation.

decisions.choice: shemurot 'enai "わたしの目のまぶた" (L), "まぶた" (B), R as the English "kept me awake"; the causatives plain ("閉じさせなかった", "眠らせなかった")
decisions.reason: The guards of the eyes are the eyelids (m1, uncertain); God is behind the sleeplessness (m2). A causative stays plain for God (PSA-1).

source.text: חִשַּׁ֣בְתִּי יָמִ֣ים מִקֶּ֑דֶם שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת עוֹלָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: I thought about days from antiquity, years of ages.

en.L: I thought about the days of old, \q the years of ages past.
en.B: I turned my mind to days gone by, \q to years long past.
en.R: I thought about the past, \q about what happened long ago.

fr.L: J’ai pensé aux jours d’autrefois, \q aux années des âges passés.
fr.B: J’ai tourné mes pensées vers les jours d’autrefois, \q vers les années lointaines.
fr.R: J’ai pensé au passé, \q à ce qui s’est passé il y a très longtemps.

sw.L: Nilizifikiri siku za kale, \q miaka ya zamani za kale.
sw.B: Niliyaelekeza mawazo yangu kwa siku zilizopita, \q kwa miaka iliyopita zamani.
sw.R: Niliwaza juu ya wakati uliopita, \q juu ya mambo yaliyotokea zamani.

es.L: Pensaba en los días de antaño, \q en los años de siglos pasados.
es.B: Me puse a pensar en los días de antes, \q en años ya lejanos.
es.R: Pensé en el pasado, \q en lo que sucedió hace mucho tiempo.

vi.L: Tôi đã suy nghĩ về những ngày xưa, \q những năm của các thời đã qua.
vi.B: Tôi hướng tâm trí về những ngày đã qua, \q về những năm tháng xa xưa.
vi.R: Tôi nghĩ về quá khứ, \q về những điều đã xảy ra từ lâu.

ko.L: 내가 옛날의 날들, \q 지나간 세월의 해들을 생각하였다.
ko.B: 나는 지나간 날들을 돌아보고, \q 오래전의 세월을 떠올렸다.
ko.R: 나는 지난날을 생각했다. \q 오래전에 있었던 일을 생각했다.

pt.L: Pensei nos dias antigos, \q nos anos de eras passadas.
pt.B: Voltei o pensamento para os dias de outrora, \q para os anos que já vão longe.
pt.R: Pensei no passado, \q no que aconteceu muito tempo atrás.

am.L: የጥንቱን ዘመን አሰብኩ፤ \q የቀድሞዎቹን ዘመናት ዓመታት [አሰብኩ]።
am.B: ያለፉትን ቀኖች አሰብኩ፤ \q ከብዙ ዘመን በፊት የነበሩትን ዓመታት አስታወስኩ።
am.R: ስላለፈው ጊዜ አሰብኩ፤ \q ከብዙ ዘመን በፊት ስለ ሆነው ነገር አሰብኩ።

hi.L: मैंने प्राचीन दिनों के बारे में सोचा, \q बीते युगों के वर्षों के बारे में।
hi.B: मैंने बीते दिनों की ओर मन लगाया, \q बहुत पहले के वर्षों की ओर।
hi.R: मैंने बीते समय के बारे में सोचा, \q उन बातों के बारे में जो बहुत पहले हुई थीं।

ru.L: Я обдумывал дни древние, \q годы веков минувших.
ru.B: Я обратился мыслями к прошедшим дням, \q к давно минувшим годам.
ru.R: Я думал о прошлом, \q о том, что было давным-давно.

ja.L: わたしは昔の日々を思い巡らした、 \q 遠い過ぎ去った年々を。
ja.B: わたしは過ぎ去った日々に、 \q はるか昔の年月に、思いを向けた。
ja.R: わたしは、昔のことを考えた。 \q ずっと前に起きたことを。

decisions.choice: days of old: the time of God's great acts
decisions.reason: The days "from of old" (qedem) are the early days of Israel, above all the rescue from Egypt that the psalm will recall in verses 16-21 (44:2; 143:5).

decisions.choice: yamim miqqedem "昔の日々" (L), "過ぎ去った日々" (B), "昔のこと" (R)
decisions.reason: The days of old are the time of God's great acts (m1).

source.text: אֶֽזְכְּרָ֥ה נְגִינָתִ֗י בַּ֫לָּ֥יְלָה עִם־לְבָבִ֥י אָשִׂ֑יחָה וַיְחַפֵּ֥שׂ רוּחִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I remember my song in the night; with my heart I muse, and searched my spirit:

en.L: I remember my song in the night; \q I muse with my heart, \q and my spirit searched:
en.B: I call to mind the songs I sang at night; \q I talk with my own heart, \q and my spirit searches for answers:
en.R: At night I remember the songs I used to sing. \q I think hard, \q and deep inside I keep asking:

fr.L: Je me souviens de mon chant dans la nuit ; \q je médite avec mon cœur, \q et mon esprit a cherché :
fr.B: Je me rappelle les chants que je chantais la nuit ; \q je m’entretiens avec mon propre cœur, \q et mon esprit cherche des réponses :
fr.R: La nuit, je me souviens des chants que je chantais autrefois. \q Je réfléchis beaucoup, \q et au fond de moi, je me demande sans cesse :

sw.L: Nakumbuka wimbo wangu usiku; \q natafakari kwa moyo wangu, \q na roho yangu ilichunguza:
sw.B: Nazikumbuka nyimbo nilizoimba usiku; \q nazungumza na moyo wangu mwenyewe, \q na roho yangu inatafuta majibu:
sw.R: Usiku nazikumbuka nyimbo nilizokuwa nikiimba. \q Nafikiri sana, \q na ndani yangu ninaendelea kuuliza:

es.L: Me acuerdo de mi canción en la noche; \q medito con mi corazón, \q y mi espíritu indagaba:
es.B: Recuerdo las canciones que cantaba de noche; \q converso con mi propio corazón, \q y mi espíritu busca respuestas:
es.R: De noche me acuerdo de las canciones que solía cantar. \q Pienso mucho, \q y en lo más hondo me sigo preguntando:

vi.L: Tôi nhớ lại bài ca của tôi ban đêm; \q tôi suy ngẫm với lòng mình, \q và tâm linh tôi tra xét:
vi.B: Tôi nhớ lại những bài ca tôi hát ban đêm; \q tôi trò chuyện với lòng mình, \q và tâm linh tôi tìm câu trả lời:
vi.R: Ban đêm tôi nhớ lại những bài ca tôi từng hát. \q Tôi suy nghĩ thật nhiều, \q và tận đáy lòng tôi cứ hỏi:

ko.L: 내가 밤에 나의 노래를 기억한다. \q 내 마음과 함께 생각에 잠기고, \q 내 영이 찾아 물었다.
ko.B: 밤에 부르던 노래를 떠올리며 \q 내 마음과 이야기하니, \q 내 영이 답을 찾아 묻는다.
ko.R: 밤이 되면 예전에 부르던 노래가 생각난다. \q 나는 깊이 생각한다. \q 그리고 마음속으로 계속 묻는다.

pt.L: Lembro-me do meu cântico na noite; \q medito com o meu coração, \q e o meu espírito investigou:
pt.B: Trago à memória as canções que eu cantava de noite; \q converso com o meu próprio coração, \q e o meu espírito busca respostas:
pt.R: À noite eu me lembro das canções que eu costumava cantar. \q Penso muito, \q e lá no fundo continuo perguntando:

am.L: በሌሊት ቅኔዬን አስታውሳለሁ፤ \q ከልቤ ጋር አሰላስላለሁ፤ \q መንፈሴም መረመረ፦
am.B: በሌሊት የዘመርኳቸውን መዝሙሮች አስታውሳለሁ፤ \q ከልቤ ጋር እነጋገራለሁ፤ \q መንፈሴም መልስ ይፈልጋል፦
am.R: በሌሊት እዘምራቸው የነበሩትን መዝሙሮች አስታውሳለሁ። \q በጥልቅ አስባለሁ፤ \q በውስጤም እንዲህ እያልኩ እጠይቃለሁ፦

hi.L: मैं रात को अपने गीत को स्मरण करता हूँ; \q मैं अपने मन से विचार करता हूँ, \q और मेरी आत्मा ने खोजबीन की:
hi.B: मैं वे गीत याद करता हूँ जो मैं रात को गाता था; \q मैं अपने ही मन से बातें करता हूँ, \q और मेरी आत्मा उत्तर खोजती है:
hi.R: रात को मुझे वे गीत याद आते हैं जो मैं पहले गाया करता था। \q मैं गहराई से सोचता हूँ, \q और भीतर ही भीतर बार-बार पूछता हूँ:

ru.L: Я вспоминаю мою песнь в ночи; \q я размышляю со своим сердцем, \q и мой дух исследовал:
ru.B: Я вспоминаю песни, которые пел по ночам; \q я беседую со своим сердцем, \q и мой дух ищет ответа:
ru.R: Ночью я вспоминаю песни, которые пел когда-то. \q Я напряжённо думаю, \q и в глубине души всё спрашиваю:

ja.L: わたしは夜の自分の歌を思い起こす。 \q わたしは自分の心と語り合い、 \q わたしの霊は探り求めた。
ja.B: わたしは、夜に歌った歌を思い出す。 \q 自分の心と語り合い、 \q わたしの霊は答えを探し求める。
ja.R: 夜になると、わたしは前に歌っていた歌を思い出す。 \q わたしは一生懸命に考え、 \q 心の奥で問い続ける。

decisions.choice: my song: music I once played and sang
decisions.reason: The word (neginah) is a song played on strings (as in the title of Psalm 76). The psalmist remembers the songs of better days, perhaps songs in the night like those of 42:9.

decisions.choice: my spirit searched: the questions that follow
decisions.reason: The searching of his spirit is put into words in the questions of verses 8-10, so this verse ends with a colon.

decisions.choice: the songs I used to sing
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that the songs belong to an earlier, happier time (m1).

decisions.choice: neginati "自分の歌" (L), "夜に歌った歌" (B), "前に歌っていた歌" (R); the questions that follow in 77:8-10 as plain questions without quotation marks, as the English
decisions.reason: My song is the music he once played and sang (m1); "my spirit searched" introduces the questions (m2), which the English sets without quotation marks.

source.text: הַֽ֭לְעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַ֥ח׀אֲדֹנָ֑י וְלֹֽא־יֹסִ֖יף לִרְצ֣וֹת עֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: Forever will reject [the] Lord, and not will he again be favorable anymore?

en.L: Will [the] Lord reject forever, \q and will {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} never again show favor?
en.B: Will the Lord turn away for all time, \q and never again show kindness?
en.R: Will the Lord turn away from us forever? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} never be kind to us again?

fr.L: Le Seigneur rejettera-t-il pour toujours, \q et ne montrera-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} plus jamais {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} faveur ?
fr.B: Le Seigneur va-t-il se détourner pour toujours, \q et ne plus jamais montrer {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bonté ?
fr.R: Le Seigneur va-t-il se détourner de nous pour toujours ? \q Ne sera-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} plus jamais bon pour nous ?

sw.L: Je, Bwana atakataa milele, \q wala hataonyesha tena kibali?
sw.B: Je, Bwana atageuka mbali siku zote, \q wala hataonyesha wema tena kamwe?
sw.R: Je, Bwana atatuacha milele? \q Je, hatatuonea wema tena kamwe?

es.L: ¿Rechazará [el] Señor para siempre, \q y nunca más {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mostrará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} favor?
es.B: ¿Se apartará el Señor por todos los tiempos, \q y nunca más mostrará bondad?
es.R: ¿Se alejará el Señor de nosotros para siempre? \q ¿Nunca más será {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} bueno con nosotros?

vi.L: Chúa sẽ từ bỏ mãi mãi sao, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chẳng bao giờ ban ơn nữa sao?
vi.B: Chúa sẽ quay lưng mãi mãi sao, \q và không bao giờ tỏ lòng nhân từ nữa sao?
vi.R: Chúa sẽ quay lưng với chúng tôi mãi mãi sao? \q Ngài sẽ không bao giờ tử tế với chúng tôi nữa sao?

ko.L: 주님께서 영원히 버리시겠는가? \q 다시는 은혜를 베풀지 않으시겠는가?
ko.B: 주님께서 영영 돌아서 버리시겠는가? \q 다시는 너그러움을 베풀지 않으시겠는가?
ko.R: 주님께서 영원히 우리를 외면하실까? \q 다시는 우리에게 친절을 베풀지 않으실까?

pt.L: Rejeitará [o] Senhor para sempre, \q e nunca mais {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mostrará favor?
pt.B: Será que o Senhor vai se afastar para sempre \q e nunca mais mostrar bondade?
pt.R: Será que o Senhor vai se afastar de nós para sempre? \q Será que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nunca mais vai ser bondoso conosco?

am.L: ጌታ ለዘላለም ይጥላልን? \q ዳግመኛስ ሞገስ አያሳይምን?
am.B: ጌታ ለዘለቄታው ፊቱን ያዞራልን? \q ከእንግዲህስ ቸርነት አያሳይምን?
am.R: ጌታ ለዘላለም ይተወናልን? \q ዳግመኛስ ደግነት አያደርግልንምን?

hi.L: क्या प्रभु सदा के लिए त्याग देंगे, \q और क्या वे फिर कभी कृपा न करेंगे?
hi.B: क्या प्रभु सदा के लिए मुँह फेर लेंगे, \q और फिर कभी दया न दिखाएँगे?
hi.R: क्या प्रभु हमसे सदा के लिए मुँह मोड़ लेंगे? \q क्या वे फिर कभी हम पर दया न करेंगे?

ru.L: Неужели навеки отвергнет Господь \q и больше никогда не явит благоволения?
ru.B: Неужели Господь отвернулся навсегда \q и никогда больше не окажет милости?
ru.R: Неужели Господь навсегда отвернётся от нас? \q Неужели {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} больше никогда не будет к нам добр?

ja.L: 主はとこしえに退けられるのか？ \q もう二度と、好意を示してくださらないのか？
ja.B: 主は、いつまでも顔を背けておられるのか？ \q もう二度と、いつくしみを示してくださらないのか？
ja.R: 主は、いつまでもわたしたちから顔を背けておられるのか？ \q もう二度と、わたしたちにやさしくしてくださらないのか？

decisions.choice: reject: cast off, turn away from
decisions.reason: The verb (zanach) is used for God casting off his people in the laments of this collection (44:10; 74:1).

decisions.choice: questions that hope for the answer no
decisions.reason: The questions of verses 8-10 voice the psalmist's fear, but each also implies that it cannot be so: God's loyal love and promises do not end.

decisions.choice: us
decisions.reason: Readable supplies the object the Hebrew leaves unsaid: God's people.

decisions.choice: "प्रभु" (Adonai), with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: The Lord here is Adonai, so it is plain "प्रभु"; where the psalm has the divine name (Yah, verse 12) the Hindi has a divine_name span, as Psalm 73:20 explains.

decisions.choice: God's negatives "示してくださらないのか？" (L, B), "やさしくしてくださらないのか？" (R), not 〜られないのか
decisions.reason: Questions that hope for the answer no (m2); 〜られない would read as "cannot" (PSA-1). Reject is cast off, turn away from (m1).

source.text: הֶאָפֵ֣ס לָנֶ֣צַח חַסְדּ֑וֹ גָּ֥מַר אֹ֝֗מֶר לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Has ceased to perpetuity his loyal love? Has come to an end [the] word for generation and generation?

en.L: Has {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love ceased forever? \q Has [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] word come to an end for generation after generation?
en.B: Is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love gone for good? \q Is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promise finished for every generation to come?
en.R: Has {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love ended for good? \q Are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promises over for all time to come?

fr.L: Son amour loyal a-t-il cessé pour toujours ? \q [Sa] parole a-t-elle pris fin pour génération après génération ?
fr.B: Son amour fidèle a-t-il disparu pour de bon ? \q Sa promesse est-elle finie pour toutes les générations à venir ?
fr.R: Son amour fidèle est-il fini pour de bon ? \q Ses promesses sont-elles terminées pour toujours ?

sw.L: Je, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma umekoma milele? \q Je, neno [{{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}] limefikia mwisho kwa kizazi baada ya kizazi?
sw.B: Je, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma umetoweka kabisa? \q Je, ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} imekwisha kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo?
sw.R: Je, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma umekwisha kabisa? \q Je, ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zimekwisha kwa wakati wote ujao?

es.L: ¿Ha cesado para siempre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal? \q ¿Se ha acabado [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] palabra de generación en generación?
es.B: ¿Se ha ido para siempre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel? \q ¿Se ha terminado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} promesa para todas las generaciones que vendrán?
es.R: ¿Se ha acabado para siempre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel? \q ¿Se han terminado {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} promesas para todo el tiempo que vendrá?

vi.L: Tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dứt đời đời sao? \q Lời [của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] đã chấm dứt cho đời này qua đời kia sao?
vi.B: Tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã mất hẳn rồi sao? \q Lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hết hiệu lực cho mọi thế hệ về sau sao?
vi.R: Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chấm dứt rồi sao? \q Những lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hết thật cho đến muôn đời sao?

ko.L: 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원히 그쳤는가? \q [그분의] 말씀이 대대로 끝났는가?
ko.B: 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 아주 사라져 버렸는가? \q 그분의 약속이 앞으로 올 모든 세대에 끝나 버렸는가?
ko.R: 그분의 변함없는 사랑이 아주 끝나 버렸을까? \q 그분의 약속이 이제 영원히 사라졌을까?

pt.L: Cessou para sempre o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal? \q Acabou-se a [{{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}}] palavra de geração em geração?
pt.B: Acabou-se de vez o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal? \q Terminou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} promessa para todas as gerações futuras?
pt.R: Será que o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor fiel acabou para sempre? \q Será que as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} promessas terminaram para sempre?

am.L: ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም አበቃን? \q [ቃሉስ] ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ ተቋረጠን?
am.B: ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘለቄታው ጠፋን? \q የሰጠው ተስፋ ቃልስ ለሚመጡት ትውልዶች ሁሉ ተቋረጠን?
am.R: ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘለቄታው አበቃን? \q የገባቸው ተስፋዎችስ ለዘላለም ቀሩን?

hi.L: क्या उनका अटल प्रेम सदा के लिए मिट गया है? \q क्या [उनका] वचन पीढ़ी से पीढ़ी तक के लिए समाप्त हो गया है?
hi.B: क्या उनका अटल प्रेम हमेशा के लिए चला गया? \q क्या उनकी प्रतिज्ञा आनेवाली हर पीढ़ी के लिए ख़त्म हो गई?
hi.R: क्या उनका अटल प्रेम सदा के लिए ख़त्म हो गया है? \q क्या उनके वादे आनेवाले सारे समय के लिए समाप्त हो गए हैं?

ru.L: Неужели навсегда прекратилась {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь? \q Неужели пришло к концу [{{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}] слово для рода и рода?
ru.B: Неужели {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменной любви больше нет? \q Неужели {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} обещание закончилось для всех грядущих поколений?
ru.R: Неужели {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь кончилась навсегда? \q Неужели {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} обещаниям пришёл конец на все времена?

ja.L: その方の誠実は、永遠に絶え果てたのか？ \q [その方の]言葉は、代々に至るまで尽きてしまったのか？
ja.B: その方の変わらぬいつくしみは、もう永久になくなったのか？ \q その方の約束は、これから先のすべての世代に対して、終わってしまったのか？
ja.R: その方の変わらぬいつくしみは、すっかり消えてしまったのか？ \q その方の約束は、これから先、もうないのか？

decisions.choice: loyal love: God's faithful covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the loyal, faithful love God has bound himself to show his people (5:8). Literal and Balanced say "loyal love", Readable "faithful love".

decisions.choice: word: a promise
decisions.reason: The word ('omer) is a spoken word; here God's word of promise to his people.

decisions.choice: promise
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what kind of word is meant (m2).

decisions.choice: loyal love (ḥesed) as "ጽኑ ፍቅር" at every level, Readable included for the English "faithful love"
decisions.reason: The terms list keeps "ጽኑ ፍቅር" for ḥesed at every level, as in the other psalms.

decisions.choice: "अटल प्रेम" at every level
decisions.reason: God's hesed is "अटल प्रेम" at every level in the poetry note, though the English varies "loyal love" and "faithful love" (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: "неизменная любовь" for God's hesed
decisions.reason: The poetry note fixes "неизменная любовь" at every level for God's hesed in the psalms.
